requirements.requirement: Build MentorLagbe as a full-stack smart tuition and mentorship platform for online and home tuition / tutor booking.
Implement exactly three application roles: student, tutor, admin.
Support both subject-wise batch tuition and 1-on-1 mentorship offerings.
Use Next.js App Router for the frontend.

Use MongoDB as the application database.

Use exactly four main application MongoDB collections named users, tuitions, applications and payments (source wording).
users: store _id, name, email and image (ImgBB optional / image URL).
users: store role restricted to student, tutor or admin.
users: store phone and bio profile fields.
users: store subscription plan with free/pro values; default free.
users: store createdAt timestamp.
users: create through BetterAuth signup; allow profile updates, admin role updates and Stripe-triggered plan updates.
tuitions: store _id, title, subject and classLevel.
tuitions: store mode as Online/Offline, location, monthlyFee and daysPerWeek.
tuitions: store bannerImage, description, tutorName and tutorEmail.
tuitions: store approvalStatus as pending/approved/rejected, isActive and createdAt.
tuitions: create and manage by owning Tutor; approval/rejection by Admin.
applications: store _id, tuitionId and tuitionTitle.
applications: store subject, monthlyFee and tutorEmail.
applications: store studentName, studentEmail and studentPhone.
applications: store preferredSchedule and studentNote.
applications: store status pending/accepted/rejected and appliedAt.
applications: create by Student; allow application status update by owning Tutor.
payments: store _id, userEmail, userName, userRole and planName.
payments: store amount, currency, transactionId and stripeSessionId.
payments: store paymentStatus paid and paidAt.
payments: create using verified Stripe Checkout/Webhook processing.
